name: stripe_api_search
description:
Search for Stripe API operations by keyword.

Returns matching operations with their HTTP method, path, summary, and top-level parameter names with types. Does not include parameter descriptions, enum values, or nested object fields — use stripe_api_details to get those before calling the relevant Stripe API execution tool.

query.description: Search query describing the Stripe API operation you want to find (e.g. 'create customer', 'list payments', 'refund charge')

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5, max: 20)
